title: Variable cell height — Height component + cuboid floor mesh + cliff auto-detection + 2D blast respects cliffs
intent: Foundation story for variable terrain height per `docs/game-design/terrain-design.md §2`. Each cell entity gains a Height component (integer 0..4). Cell floor mesh becomes a CUBOID of dimensions (1, h+1, 1) — bomber walks on top. Adjacent cells with different heights create CLIFFS — adjacency between such cells is blocked for movement (handled by GridOccupancy) and blast propagation (handled by BlastPropagationSystem). Pure 2D-on-the-grid rule: gameplay logic unchanged, only Y elevations + cliff-as-wall rule added. Bombers + bombs + pickups sit on top of their cell at Y=cell.height. Map stays logically 2D — one bomber per XZ cell, no atop-of-each-other. Visual richness + tactical depth (vertical advantage in combat) unlocked.
rationale: Source: user request 2026-05-28 + `docs/game-design/terrain-design.md` (this batch). Foundation of three-story terrain track — ramps (GDP-011) + floor Wang tiles (GDP-012) layer on top. Marked `should` because gameplay is significantly enriched by vertical positioning (height = positional advantage). Pairs natively with shipped systems: Throw Glove (S144) gains 'bomb up onto cliff' verb; bot AI pathfinding needs minor extension to respect cliffs.
acceptanceHints: READ FIRST: `docs/game-design/terrain-design.md §2` — canonical rules. This story implements §2.1, §2.2, §2.4 (cliff blocking), §2.5 (pathfinding), §2.6 (cuboid mesh).
SCHEMA — examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json (or engine/grid/components/):
Height component { value: integer (0..4) }. Default 0 (current behaviour preserved on cells without it).
Cliff component (auto-computed, not user-authored): tags the EDGE between two cells with different heights. Stores from + to entity ids + delta.
SCENE FILE FORMAT EXTENSION:

Scene entities gain optional `heightmap?: number[][]` field — a 2D array matching arena width × depth. Each entry = the cell's height. Default fully-zero. Scene-load reads heightmap + writes Height component on each cell entity.
Alternative authoring: per-cell `Height` component embedded in the cell entity's components block. Both supported — heightmap is the bulk-author shortcut, per-cell is the override.
ENGINE / PROJECT SYSTEM PLACEMENT:

Height component is GENERIC — `engine/grid/components/height.schema.json` is the right home (any grid-based AGF project benefits). The auto-compute Cliff marker also lives at engine/grid/ as cliff-compute-system.ts.
Project-side (Kaboom Crew): bootstrap registers the cuboid-mesh builder + arena scenes ship heightmaps.
MESH BUILDER (examples/kaboom-crew/src/blocks/floor-cell-builder.ts or extends GDP-2026-05-28-003 floor-tile-variants):
Replace flat-floor-mesh path with cuboid: BoxGeometry of size (1, height + 1, 1), centred at (0, height/2, 0). Top face at Y=height, bottom at Y=0, side faces vertical.
Top face uses existing floor-tile material; side faces use NEW `cliff-face` material (vertical stripe / panel pattern in darker palette variant — palette.floor-primary × 0.6 bottom shadow).
Special case: height=0 cells render as the current flat tile (current floor stays unchanged on flat arenas).
BOMBER + BOMB + PICKUP POSITIONING:
Existing GridMover + scene spawn-cell logic writes Transform.position.xz from GridPosition. New: Transform.position.y = referencedCell.height.
Update bomber-tree-spawner (S102) + bomb-placement-system + pickup-spawn-system: when computing Transform on entity creation, read the cell's Height and add it.
CLIFF COMPUTE SYSTEM (engine/grid/cliff-compute-system.ts):

Runs at scene load + on Height-change events. For each pair of adjacent cells (A, B): if |A.height - B.height| > 0 AND no Ramp connects them (Ramp lands in GDP-011 — for this story, just check height delta), spawn a Cliff marker entity between them.
Cliff entity exists purely as an EDGE marker — no mesh, no Transform. Just a relational tag for GridOccupancy + BlastPropagation to check.
GRID OCCUPANCY EXTENSION:

Movement validation (GridOccupancySystem when a bomber attempts to enter a cell): if the destination cell is across a Cliff from the bomber's current cell → traversal refused (treated as hard-block edge). Bomber stops at the cliff edge.
EXCEPTION: in GDP-2026-05-28-011 Ramp adds the bypass path. For THIS story (010), every cliff is impassable — gameplay-testable. Ramps come in the next story.
BLAST PROPAGATION EXTENSION:
Per terrain-design.md §2.4: blast walks XZ cardinals. When the next cell is across a Cliff → blast STOPS at the cliff edge (treated as hard block).
No BlastTile spawned beyond the cliff. Implementation: existing blast-propagation-system gains one extra check in its per-cell loop.
PATHFINDING (extend agent-goto-system.ts S82 + bot-ai-system.ts):
BFS / direction selector treats Cliff-bordered adjacencies as IMPASSABLE. Bot paths around cliffs OR avoids reaching cliff-isolated cells.
agent.gotoCell from the agent probe surface also respects cliffs (the same query path).
CAMERA EXTENSION (small piggy-back on S163 GDP-027-014 camera follow):

Camera target Y tracks Transform.position.y of the local bomber. When bomber walks onto a higher cell → camera rises proportionally + dampens (same lerp as existing XZ follow). Bombers on H=4 cells get framed at H=4 elevation.
VISUAL DETAILS — cliff face shading:

Cliff face material in `examples/kaboom-crew/src/shaders/` (or extend existing material module): vertical-band-stripe shader uniform that darkens lower portions of the side face (palette × 0.6 at Y=0, palette × 1.0 at Y=top). Sells 'depth' visually.
Optional: thin horizontal line at each integer height step (panel-seam-style detail). Sells 'stacked masonry' feel.
MULTIPLAYER (server-authoritative gameplay from S125):
Server reads heightmap from scene config; computes Cliff markers; uses them for blast + movement validation.
Heightmap shipped to client in scene-load message (or joinWorld). Small data.
No new protocol messages — Transform.position.y already in snapshot.
BACKWARDS COMPATIBILITY:
Existing arena scene files have no heightmap → all cells at H=0 → flat arena, no cliffs, no behavioural change. Bot-vs-bot regression test passes unchanged on default arena.
Existing 6 arena variants (default + wide + corridor + plaza + cross + pit) stay flat. NEW height-aware arenas ship as ADDITIONAL scenes.
PROTOTYPE ARENA (in this story):

Ship ONE new scene `examples/kaboom-crew/scenes/cliffside.scene.json` — 15×11 arena with a 3×3 elevated plateau (H=2) in the centre. Cliff walls on all 4 edges of the plateau (no ramps in this story — bombers can't reach the plateau yet; that's GDP-011's payoff). Demonstrates cliff blocking + visual.
TESTS:
Bomber on (5, 5, H=0) attempts to move to (5, 6, H=2) → traversal refused, bomber stops.
Bomb at (4, 5, H=0) with range 3 → blast at (5,5) (same height), stops at cliff before reaching (5,6,H=2).
Bomber on plateau (8, 5, H=2) cannot walk to (7, 5, H=0) → traversal refused.
Plateau cells are cuboid meshes Y=0..H=2.
Camera lerps Y when bomber walks onto / off a cliff (well, in GDP-010 bomber CAN'T walk onto cliff — but the camera path is correct for when ramps land).
OUT OF SCOPE — promised for follow-ups:
Ramp tiles (GDP-2026-05-28-011 next).
Floor Wang tiles + wall-shadow (GDP-2026-05-28-012 next-next).
Heights > 4 (defer to MVP-4).
Animated cliff face (waterfalls etc).
Vertical-axis blast propagation (stays 2D, cliffs block).
Diagonal cliffs (4-cardinal only).
